title: BUG: G6 Calibration Issue
symptom: After stopping an old sensor and starting a new one without waiting for the stop to complete, xDrip started giving readings before the 2-hour warmup and kept showing blood sugar as 40 mg/dL when finger sticks showed 124 or 111 mg/dL. Calibration attempts were refused.
cause: The user likely did not wait long enough for the sensor stop request to complete before starting a new sensor session, leading to the new sensor being started incorrectly.
fix: No definitive fix was provided in the thread. The user switched back to the official Dexcom app. Another user suggested that the official Dexcom app may be necessary to start new sensors, but xDrip can pick up the session once past calibration.
evidence_quote: Thus it seems I must not have waited long enough for the sensor stop request to complete.
